scripts.preinstall: sh -c 'rm -f package-lock.json yarn.lock; case "$npm_config_user_agent" in pnpm/*) ;; *) if [ -n "$PNPM_HOME" ] || [ -n "$NETLIFY" ] || [ "$CI" = "true" ]; then exit 0; fi; echo "Use pnpm instead" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac'
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && PORT=8080 BASE_PATH=/ pnpm --filter "./artifacts/cucci" run build && pnpm -r --if-present --filter "!./artifacts/mockup-sandbox" --filter "!./artifacts/cucci" run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
